name: Inverted Veer Power Read
formation: Gun Spread Right Slot, TE Right

summary.motive: Use a jet sweep presentation to displace the playside end, then attack the vacated interior with a quarterback pull.
summary.whyItWorks: Full-speed motion makes the sweep credible enough to move the end laterally, and the inverted geometry means his displacement opens the box instead of the edge.
summary.failureMode: The end squeezes down on the flip instead of chasing width, sitting exactly where the pull wants to go.

beats.title: 1. Jet Sweep Sets the Trap
beats.text: The slot crosses at dead sprint and the quarterback flips him the sweep look. The playside end cannot resist widening to chase the perimeter threat.

beats.title: 2. The End Chases the Motion
beats.text: With the end committed outside-in on the sweep, the entire B-gap and A-gap collapse inward with nobody home to defend them.

beats.title: 3. Pull Into the Vacated Box
beats.text: The quarterback pulls the ball off the jet flip and keeps it inside, where the offset back is already kicking the Mike out of his path.

beats.title: 4. Inside Finish Behind the Lead Block
beats.text: The keeper climbs through the scooped A-gap while both safeties trigger late, finishing upfield through the middle of the defense.

relations.tell: The ballcarrier crosses the formation before the mesh ever happens — classic zone reads have no motion at the snap.
